id: title:jabahamondes:expose the channel source drill down level

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a selectable option in the Marketing Analytics channel attribution dropdown, allowing users to view combined 'Channel + Source' data alongside existing separate options.
review.reason: Adds a single dropdown option exposing a combined attribute, a narrow, localized UI change.
review.uncertainty: No backend implementation or test assertions are supplied; the benefit is inferred solely from the option's existence, not its behavior or impact.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 is supplied. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new row to the channel selection dropdown, exposing a combined 'Channel + Source' option alongside existing 'Channel' and 'Source' options.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users to select a combined channel and source attribute, potentially changing the granularity of marketing attribution reports compared to selecting channel or source alone.
